title: NotQuiteDead
description: Become a zombie, husk, and drowned in survival!
body:
Have you ever wanted to become a zombie, husk, or drowned by being infected by them? Well now you can! When any type of zombie tries to kill you, there is a 50% chance to become one of them! You will be just like them once you transform. You will also even be able to infect other players too as a zombie! If you die as a zombie you spawn back as a normal human player.

⚠️**WARNING**⚠️
- There is currently a visual issue on the client side where if you are a zombie you appear smaller then usual. But don't worry! Everyone else sees you as a normal size zombie!

Make sure to install **ProtocolLib** plugin and **Lib's Disguises** plugin! They are requird!
